title: PwD Accessing Notifications - Functional Test Plan (22 Test Cases)
overview: Functional testing of SCRUM-290: PwD user views and manages notifications. Validates bell icon with unread badge, dropdown panel, full notifications page, mark read, dismiss, notification types, empty state, keyboard navigation, mobile viewport, and performance.

testCases.title: Notification bell icon visible in header
steps: Verify bell icon or notification element visible in header.
expectedResults: Bell icon is visible in the header.

testCases.title: Bell icon shows unread count badge
steps: Verify unread count badge is present near bell icon.

testCases.title: Clicking bell opens notification dropdown
steps: Verify dropdown panel opens without page reload.
testCases.preconditions: PwD is on an authenticated page.

testCases.title: Dropdown shows Notifications header
View All Notifications link navigates to full page
expectedResults: View All Notifications link is present.

testCases.title: Notifications page loads with title
steps: Verify page loads with notification content.

testCases.title: Notifications displayed in reverse chronological order
steps: Verify notifications are listed newest first.

testCases.title: Unread notifications visually distinguishable
steps: Verify unread notifications have distinct visual style.

testCases.title: Each notification shows type icon, message, and timestamp
steps: Verify each notification card has icon, message, and timestamp.
expectedResults: Notification cards show icon, message, timestamp.

testCases.title: Unread count badge reflects actual unread count
steps: Verify unread badge count matches actual unread notifications.

testCases.title: Mark individual notification as read
steps: Check for mark as read button on individual notification.
expectedResults: Mark as read button is present.

testCases.title: Mark all read marks all notifications as read
expectedResults: Mark all read button is present.

testCases.title: Read status persists across page reload
Dismiss button visible on dismissable notifications
steps: Check for dismiss/close button on notifications.

testCases.title: Dismissed notification removed from list
Clicking actionable notification navigates to context
Notifications are private to logged-in user
steps: Verify URL is on the correct domain.
expectedResults: Notifications are private to the user.

testCases.title: Empty state shows no notifications message
steps: Verify page handles empty state gracefully.

testCases.title: Bell icon is keyboard accessible
Notifications page renders on mobile viewport
Notifications load within 3 seconds
steps: Measure load time for notifications page.

testCases.title: Notification count updates after user action
steps: Verify page content is present after actions.
